units.source_text: ……我迄今一直叙述着有关我从幼年起记忆的无力，但我应该说突然复苏的记忆也带来了起死回生的力量。

en.t: Until now I have been describing the powerlessness of the memories I have carried since childhood, but I should say that memories suddenly revived also brought with them a life-restoring force.

units.source_text: 过去，不仅把我们拉回到过去的境域。

en.t: The past does not merely pull us back into the realm of the past.

units.source_text: 过去种种的回忆，也许为数甚少，但却有强韧的钢发条，

en.t: The various memories of the past may be few in number, yet they possess resilient steel springs,

units.source_text: 而且现在我们一接触，发条就会立即伸长，把我们弹回到未来。

en.t: and the moment we touch them in the present, those springs instantly stretch out and fling us back toward the future.
